name: path-traversal
prompt: Security review: resolveInside in src/files.js can be tricked into serving files outside the storage root (for example a root of /srv/data accepts /srv/data2/secret, and '..' segments are not handled safely). Fix it: return the absolute, normalized path only when it is the root itself or inside it; otherwise throw an Error with code 'EOUTSIDE'. It must work with both Windows and POSIX paths on the machine it runs on.
